text:
Marta: Small design QA from today's review: compare grid behaves oddly when both version-pinned rows and heavy performance badges exist. The grid height shifts and the pin CTA sometimes gets clipped on narrow widths. Screenshot attached.

Dev: Repro: open compare, pin a version, apply 4 metrics badges on another row, shrink window -> pin button clips under the sticky header. Likely a z-index + sticky height calc bug.

Sam: For UX decision: should pinned rows be promoted (sticky at top) or kept inline but visually outlined? Promotion keeps the pinned rows visible but changes ordering semantics. We need to decide.

Anya: I prefer inline pinned rows with a persistent outline + a small pinned badge. Promoting to top could confuse comparisons because row order changes. Also outline + subtle background makes scanning easier without reordering.

Jorge: Accessibility: if pinned rows are sticky at top we need to ensure assistive tech is aware of the change; aria-live announce "Pinned row moved to top" might be jarring. Inline highlight is safer. Also the current green badge color is borderline; switch to `success-600` and add icon + text, not color alone.

Dev: Implementation note: to avoid clipping, make the pin CTA part of a separate fixed column (right-aligned) that doesn't overlap sticky headers. That also lets us keep pins visible during horizontal scroll.

Marta: What about the performance badges overflow? If we show 4-5 badges they push row height up. Proposal: show 2 badges inline, then a compact "more" chip that opens a popover with the rest. The more chip should have aria-expanded and announce count like "+3 metrics".

Sam: Sounds good. Also add a small affordance for keyboard users to cycle the badges (left/right).

Anya: Microcopy tweak: change pin tooltip from "Pin version" to "Pin this version to keep it in your comparison". For the more-popover tooltip: "View additional performance metrics". Keep language consistent with catalog copy.

Dev: I'll prototype the fixed pin column + +N chip. Will ensure roving tabindex for badge navigation and proper aria attributes on the popover. ETA: tomorrow.

design-bot: Updated figma frame uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/.../compare-pin-cta-fix  comments enabled for @Marta @Dev @Anya.

Marta: Great. Lock these changes for the patch and we'll validate on internal accessibility pass. If any last nits post here by EOD.
